selection_rule: each scenario was rebuilt with fresh identities until every route body it produced carried the committed capture's structural signature; attempts per group are recorded
signature: per body: revision_selection.state, before/after statement state, family_context.state, per family entry in order (display_label, entry state, selection state, per side: side state, members_total, roster page state, (member label, member state) pairs in served order), and the published page's (state, total, returned, remaining); familyPaging: every walk body
scope: Real review-route bodies over disposable enclosures built by the repository's own test builders; test evidence, not product knowledge or mounted acceptance. Fixtures not listed here keep their original capture.
